guide.title: Guide – {{moduleName}}
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamCong.intro: Record and manage employee working days and check-in/check-out times.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamCong.overvie: The Attendance module is used to record and manage employee working days and check-in/check-out times. Users: employees (view personal timesheet), managers (approve attendance), HR (consolidation and reports).
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamCong.permiss:
• View: See timesheets within your scope.
• Create/Update: Employees create/edit their own records (if configured); managers edit according to permissions.
• Approve: Direct manager or HR approves attendance (depends on setup).
• Export: Export attendance reports.
• Admin: Configure attendance rules and shifts.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamCong.workflo:
1. Employees: Check-in/out recorded automatically or entered manually (depends on config).
2. End of period: Manager opens the period timesheet, reviews and approves.
3. Status: Draft → Pending approval → Approved. If rejected, employee corrects and resubmits.
4. After approval: Data is used for payroll consolidation.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamCong.quickSt:
1. Go to menu Administration → Attendance.
2. Select period (month/week) and department (if you are a manager or HR).
3. View the timesheet list; click an employee to see daily details.
4. If you have approve permission: Select the timesheet and click "Approve" after review.
5. Export report if needed via the Export button.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamCong.glossar:
• Timesheet: Summary of working days and check-in/out in a period for an employee.
• Approve attendance: Confirm the timesheet is correct so it can be used for payroll.
• Shift: Defined time window (e.g. 8am–5pm) used to compare with actual times.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamCong.faq:
• Why don't I see the Approve button? You need the "Approve" permission for the Attendance module in role settings.
• How do I edit recorded check-in/out times? If the module allows edits, open the timesheet detail and change (may require manager permission).
• Can approval be undone? Depends on configuration; usually admin or HR is required.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamCong.contact: Contact the HR & Administration team for attendance and payroll support.
Real-time attendance tracking and consolidated timesheets by employee.

The Attendance summary module shows real-time check-in/check-out status and timesheets by employee and department. Used by managers and HR for reporting; employees may view their scope (per permissions).

• View: See Real-time and Timesheet tabs within your scope.
• Export: Export reports (if available).
• Admin: Configure scope and display rules.

1. Real-time tab: View employees' current status (present, not checked in, checked out) and check-in/out times.
2. Timesheet tab: Select period and department; view each employee's timesheet and open daily details.
3. Data is used for approval and payroll.

1. Go to Administration → Attendance summary.
2. Real-time tab: See current status of employees (present, not checked in, checked out).
3. Timesheet tab: Select month and department; click an employee to see daily details.
4. Export reports if needed.

• Real-time: Screen showing current attendance status for each employee.
• Consolidated timesheet: Summary of working days and check-in/out for multiple employees in a period.

• Why don't I see the Timesheet tab? Check module view permission and department scope.
• How is real-time data updated? It reflects the latest check-in/check-out records.
Contact HR & Administration for attendance summary support.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_phieuHanhChinh.i: Request and approve administrative forms (leave, late, overtime…); manager and HR approval workflow.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_phieuHanhChinh.o: The Admin form module lets employees create requests (leave, late, overtime, etc.). Direct manager approves first, then HR. Tabs: My forms, I manage, Quota (monthly allowance per form type).
guide.modules.hanhChinh_phieuHanhChinh.p:
• View: See forms in scope (yours or your reports).
• Create/Update: Employees create/edit their forms (before submit).
• Approve: Manager approves; HR approves after manager.
• Reject: Manager/HR can reject forms.
• Export: Export form lists.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_phieuHanhChinh.w:
1. Employee creates a form (type, shift, date, reason), submits.
2. Status: Draft → Pending manager → Manager approved → Pending HR → Approved (or Rejected at manager/HR step).
3. Quota: Each form type has a monthly allowance; Quota tab shows used vs remaining.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_phieuHanhChinh.q:
1. Go to Administration → Admin forms.
2. My forms tab: Click Create, choose type (leave, late…), shift, date, reason, submit.
3. I manage tab: View reports' forms; click Manager approve or HR approve (by role).
4. Quota tab: View forms used this month by type.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_phieuHanhChinh.g:
• Form type: Leave, Late, Overtime, etc. (configured in Payroll setup).
• Manager approve: Direct manager confirms the form.
• HR approve: HR confirms after manager approval.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_phieuHanhChinh.f:
• Why can't I create a form? Check quota (remaining forms this month) and create permission.
• Form was rejected—what to do? Edit the form (if still draft) or create a new one with a clearer reason.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_phieuHanhChinh.c: Contact HR & Administration for admin form support.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamDiemKpi.intr: Evaluate and record KPI scores by period and employee; view My KPI and I manage reports.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamDiemKpi.over: The KPI scoring module records employee KPI scores by evaluation period. Employees view their scores (My KPI tab); managers enter scores for reports (I manage tab) and view statistics.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamDiemKpi.perm:
• View: See KPI scores in scope (yours or your reports).
• Create/Update: Managers enter or edit KPI scores for employees.
• Export: Export KPI reports.
• Admin: Configure evaluation periods and scales.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamDiemKpi.work:
1. Each period (month/quarter): Manager opens the list of employees to score and enters KPI scores.
2. Employees view their scores in My KPI tab.
3. KPI scores feed into payroll (KPI pay) in the Payroll module.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamDiemKpi.quic:
1. Go to Administration → KPI scoring.
2. My KPI tab: View your KPI scores by period.
3. I manage tab: Select period, view employees; click an employee to enter or edit KPI score.
4. Statistics tab: View aggregated scores by department and period.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamDiemKpi.glos:
• KPI: Key performance indicator.
• Evaluation period: Time span (month/quarter) for which KPI is scored.
• KPI score: Score achieved, used to calculate KPI pay.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamDiemKpi.faq:
• Why don't I see the score button? You need permission to enter/edit scores for employees (manager or HR).
• How does KPI affect pay? KPI score is used in Payroll module to calculate KPI pay.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_chamDiemKpi.cont: Contact HR & Administration for KPI scoring support.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_bangLuong.intro: Calculate pay, view payslips and reports by period; My pay and Manage tabs.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_bangLuong.overvi: The Payroll module aggregates data from Attendance, Add/deduct points, and KPI scoring to compute monthly pay per employee. Employees view their payslip (My pay); managers/HR view full payroll (List) and statistics.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_bangLuong.permis:
• View: See payroll/payslips in scope (yours or employees).
• Export: Export payslips and payroll reports.
• Admin: Configure formulas and lock periods.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_bangLuong.workfl:
1. Once data is ready (attendance, add/deduct, KPI), the system calculates pay from config.
2. Employees view their monthly payslip in My pay tab.
3. Managers/HR view payroll list and statistics by department and period.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_bangLuong.quickS:
1. Go to Administration → Payroll.
2. My pay tab: Select month to view your payslip.
3. List tab: (Managers/HR) Select month and department; view payroll per employee, click for details.
4. Statistics tab: View payroll summary by department and period.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_bangLuong.glossa:
• Payslip: Detailed monthly pay for one employee (base, KPI, add/deduct, total).
• Payroll: Set of payslips for multiple employees in one period.
• Pay period: Month for which pay is calculated.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_bangLuong.faq:
• Why don't I have a payslip for this month? You need complete attendance, add/deduct, and KPI data; the period may not be open or still calculating.
• How to correct wrong figures on payslip? Usually fix source data (attendance, points, KPI); then recalculate if you have permission.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_bangLuong.contac: Contact HR & Administration for payroll support.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_diemCongTru.intr: Record add/deduct points for employees by month; used for payroll.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_diemCongTru.over: The Add/deduct points module records bonus or penalty points per employee per month (spot bonus, policy violation, etc.). Data feeds into Payroll. Managers/HR enter points; employees may view (per permission).
guide.modules.hanhChinh_diemCongTru.perm:
• View: See add/deduct records in scope.
• Create/Update: Managers/HR add or edit add/deduct records.
• Delete: Delete records (before period lock).
• Export: Export reports.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_diemCongTru.work:
1. Monthly: Managers/HR add add (e.g. bonus) or deduct (e.g. violation) entries for employees.
2. Each record has type (add/deduct), amount or points, reason, and applied month.
3. Data is aggregated into Payroll when calculating monthly pay.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_diemCongTru.quic:
1. Go to Administration → Add/deduct points.
2. Select month and department (if manager).
3. Click Create: Select employee, type (Add / Deduct), amount or points, reason, save.
4. Edit or delete records before the pay period is locked.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_diemCongTru.glos:
• Add points: Bonus, positive recognition (money or points).
• Deduct points: Penalty, deduction (money or points) for violations.
• Applied period: Month in which add/deduct is included in pay.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_diemCongTru.faq:
• I don't see the Create button? You need create/edit permission for add/deduct (manager or HR).
• Can I edit add/deduct after saving? Yes, before the pay period is locked; after lock contact admin.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_diemCongTru.cont: Contact HR & Administration for add/deduct points support.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_thietLapCongLuon: Configure attendance Wi-Fi, admin form groups and point groups (pay coefficients) for payroll.

Payroll setup has three parts: (1) IP/Wi-Fi: Networks allowed for check-in/out. (2) Admin form groups: Form types (leave, late…) and quotas. (3) Point groups: Coefficients and point groups used in pay calculation. Only admin or HR configures.

• View: View current config.
• Create/Update: Add or edit IP/Wi-Fi, form groups, point groups.
• Delete: Remove config (use care with data in use).
• Admin: Full payroll setup permission.

1. IP tab: Add IP or Wi-Fi names allowed for check-in/out (on-site attendance).
2. Admin form groups tab: Define form types (name, code) and monthly quota.
3. Point groups tab: Define point groups (coefficients) used in pay formulas.

1. Go to Administration → Payroll setup.
2. IP tab: Add IP or Wi-Fi allowed for attendance.
3. Admin form groups tab: Add form type (e.g. Leave), quota per month.
4. Point groups tab: Add point group (name, coefficient) for pay calculation.

• IP/Wi-Fi: Network allowed for check-in/out; prevents off-site attendance.
• Admin form groups: Form types (leave, late, overtime…) and monthly allowances.
• Point groups: Coefficients and scales used in pay formulas.

• Why can't I check in? Ensure you're on a network (Wi-Fi/IP) added in IP settings.
• Where to add a new form type? Admin form groups tab, click Create, enter name and quota.
Contact HR & Administration or system admin for payroll setup support.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_khauHaoTaiSan.in: Calculate depreciation by period (month/year), report book value and accumulated depreciation.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_khauHaoTaiSan.ov: The Asset depreciation module lets you create depreciation periods (month/year), compute depreciation per asset (using asset group and depreciation parameters from Asset setup), and close the period to update book value and accumulated depreciation on the asset list. The Statistics tab aggregates by group.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_khauHaoTaiSan.pe:
• View: See period list, detail, and statistics.
• Create/Edit: Create a new period (month/year); only draft periods can be edited or deleted.
• Calculate: Run period depreciation (draft only).
• Close period: Update book value and accumulated depreciation on assets (draft only, after Calculate).
guide.modules.hanhChinh_khauHaoTaiSan.wo:
1. Asset setup: Configure asset groups with depreciation method (straight line/declining balance), rate % or useful life.
2. Asset list: Enter cost and depreciation start date (default = date in).
3. Depreciation periods tab: Create period (month/year) → Click "Calculate" to build detail table → Review → Click "Close period" to update asset records.
4. Statistics tab: View total cost, total accumulated depreciation, total book value; table by group.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_khauHaoTaiSan.qu:
1. Go to Administration → Asset depreciation.
2. "Depreciation periods" tab: Click "Create period", choose Month and Year, save.
3. Open the new period → Click "Calculate" to generate the depreciation-by-asset table.
4. After review, click "Close period" to update book value and accumulated depreciation on the asset list.
5. "Statistics" tab: View summary and table by group.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_khauHaoTaiSan.gl:
• Depreciation period: One month in one year used to compute and close depreciation.
• Period depreciation: Amount of depreciation for that month.
• Book value: Cost minus accumulated depreciation.
• Close period: Confirm the calculation and update asset records (cannot be changed after close).
guide.modules.hanhChinh_khauHaoTaiSan.fa:
• Why are there no assets in the detail table? Check that assets have cost, depreciation start date <= end of period month, and that the asset group has rate or useful life configured in Asset setup.
• Can I edit a closed period? No; closed periods are view-only.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_khauHaoTaiSan.co: Contact HR & Administration or accounting for asset depreciation support.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_danhMucTaiSan.in: Manage the asset catalog: full list, my assets, and statistics by group, location, and status.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_danhMucTaiSan.ov: The Asset catalog module has List (all assets, filter by group, location, status), My assets (assets assigned to me), and Statistics (charts and tables by group/location/status). You can create handover/return or maintenance slips from asset detail. List can be exported to Excel/PDF.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_danhMucTaiSan.pe:
• View: See asset list within scope (admin sees all; users may see by department/scope).
• Create/Edit: Add and edit assets (code, name, group, location, status, cost, holder…).
• Delete: Remove assets (ensure no dependent data).
• Export: Export list and statistics to Excel/PDF.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_danhMucTaiSan.wo:
1. Set up Asset setup (groups, locations, statuses) before adding assets.
2. List tab: Add assets; from detail you can create handover/return or maintenance slips.
3. My assets tab: View assets assigned to you.
4. Statistics tab: View summary, charts and tables by group/location/status; export reports.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_danhMucTaiSan.qu:
1. Go to Administration → Asset catalog.
2. "List" tab: Click Add, enter code, name, group, location, status, cost, save.
3. Open an asset to view detail; from here you can create handover/return or maintenance slips.
4. Use filters (group, location, status) and Export to Excel/PDF.
5. "Statistics" tab: View charts and tables, export if needed.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_danhMucTaiSan.gl:
• Asset group: Category (e.g. IT, Furniture); configured in Asset setup.
• Location: Storage place (warehouse, room, branch); configured in Locations.
• Asset status: Usage status (e.g. In use, Maintenance); configured in Asset setup.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_danhMucTaiSan.fa:
• Why don't I see some assets? Check filters and permissions (users may only see assets in scope).
• How to create a handover slip from an asset? Open asset detail, click "Create handover/return slip".
guide.modules.hanhChinh_danhMucTaiSan.co: Contact HR & Administration for asset catalog support.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_noiQuanLy.intro: Manage asset storage locations (warehouse, room, branch); view assets at each location.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_noiQuanLy.overvi: The Locations module is used to define and manage storage locations (warehouse, department, branch). Each location has a code and name and can be linked to a branch. From a location’s detail you can see assets at that location and open the Asset catalog filtered by that location.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_noiQuanLy.permis:
• View: See location list and details.
• Create/Edit: Add and edit locations (code, name, branch).
• Delete: Delete a location (only when no assets use it).
• Export: Export reports if available.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_noiQuanLy.workfl:
1. Add location: Code, name, branch (if any).
2. In location detail: View assets at this location; click "View all" to open Asset catalog filtered by this location.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_noiQuanLy.quickS:
1. Go to Administration → Locations.
2. Click Add, enter code and name, select branch if any, save.
3. Click a location to view detail and assets at that location.
4. Click "View all" to go to Asset catalog with location filter.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_noiQuanLy.glossa:
• Location: Storage place (warehouse, room, cabinet).
• Branch: Subsidiary unit (for multi-branch organizations).
guide.modules.hanhChinh_noiQuanLy.faq:
• Can't delete a location? Ensure no assets are assigned to it.
• Where do "assets at location" come from? From the asset catalog where the "Location" column matches this location.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_noiQuanLy.contac: Contact HR & Administration for location management support.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_thietLapTaiSan.i: Configure asset groups and asset statuses; used by asset catalog and depreciation.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_thietLapTaiSan.o: The Asset setup module has Asset groups (categories, optional depreciation method) and Statuses (usage statuses: in use, maintenance…). Groups and statuses are used in Asset catalog and Depreciation. From group/status detail you can view assets in that group or with that status.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_thietLapTaiSan.p:
• View: See asset groups and statuses.
• Create/Edit: Add and edit groups (code, name, depreciation…) or statuses.
• Delete: Delete group/status only when no assets use it.
• Export: Export reports if available.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_thietLapTaiSan.w:
1. Asset groups tab: Add groups; optionally set depreciation method and rate for Asset depreciation.
2. Statuses tab: Add statuses (code, name) to assign to assets in the catalog.
3. From detail: View assets in group or with status; "View all" opens Asset catalog with that filter.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_thietLapTaiSan.q:
1. Go to Administration → Asset setup.
2. "Asset groups" tab: Click Add, enter code and name; if using depreciation, set method and rate.
3. "Statuses" tab: Add statuses (e.g. In use, Maintenance).
4. Click a group or status to view detail and related assets.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_thietLapTaiSan.g:
• Asset group: Category (IT, Furniture…); can have depreciation parameters.
• Asset status: Usage status (In use, Maintenance, Disposed…).
guide.modules.hanhChinh_thietLapTaiSan.f:
• Why can't I delete a group? Assets still use it; reassign or delete those assets first.
• Do links from Asset catalog open the right group/status? Yes; the Group/Location/Status columns in the asset table link to the corresponding module with the selected record.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_thietLapTaiSan.c: Contact HR & Administration for asset setup support.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_capPhatThuHoi.in: Create handover and return slips for assets; track location and holder changes.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_capPhatThuHoi.ov: The Handover/return module is used to create handover slips (assign asset to an employee) or return slips (return asset to storage). Each slip is linked to one asset, previous/new location, previous/new holder, and execution date. The Statistics tab aggregates by slip type, location, and executor; Excel export is available.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_capPhatThuHoi.pe:
• View: See slip list within scope.
• Create/Edit: Create handover or return slips, edit slips (if not locked).
• Delete: Delete slips (may affect asset data).
• Export: Export slip list and statistics.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_capPhatThuHoi.wo:
1. Create slip: Choose type (Handover / Return), select asset; fill previous/new location, previous/new holder, date, executor.
2. After save, asset location and holder are updated.
3. Statistics tab: Filter by type, location, executor; export Excel.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_capPhatThuHoi.qu:
1. Go to Administration → Handover/return.
2. Click Create slip, choose Handover or Return, select asset.
3. Fill location and holder (before/after), date, executor, notes, save.
4. Statistics tab: View summary, use filters and export Excel.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_capPhatThuHoi.gl:
• Handover slip: Records assigning an asset to an employee (new holder).
• Return slip: Records returning an asset to storage.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_capPhatThuHoi.fa:
• Does the asset update after creating a slip? Yes; asset location and holder are updated.
• Can I edit a saved slip? Depends on configuration; if allowed, edit from the slip list (ensure asset stays in sync).
guide.modules.hanhChinh_capPhatThuHoi.co: Contact HR & Administration for handover/return support.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_kiemKeTaiSan.int: Create inventory rounds and reconcile physical assets with records; report by status.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_kiemKeTaiSan.ove: The Asset inventory module is used to create inventory rounds (by time/scope), record reconciliation results per asset (correct location, wrong location, missing…). The Statistics tab aggregates by round and status; reports can be exported.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_kiemKeTaiSan.per:
• View: See inventory rounds and details, statistics.
• Create/Edit: Create rounds, update reconciliation results per asset.
• Delete: Delete rounds or records (by permission).
• Export: Export inventory reports.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_kiemKeTaiSan.wor:
1. Create round: Name, time, scope (if any).
2. In round: Reconcile each asset (correct/wrong location, missing, extra…), update status and notes.
3. Close round: Summarize; optionally update asset location/status from results.
4. Statistics tab: View by round and status; export.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_kiemKeTaiSan.qui:
1. Go to Administration → Asset inventory.
2. Click Create round, enter name and time, save.
3. Open round, add/reconcile assets: mark correct/wrong location, missing, extra…
4. Statistics tab: View summary and export.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_kiemKeTaiSan.glo:
• Inventory round: A single inventory run in a time period.
• Reconciliation: Compare physical assets with records (correct/wrong location, missing, extra).
guide.modules.hanhChinh_kiemKeTaiSan.faq:
• Do inventory results update the asset catalog? They can; depending on setup, asset location/status are updated from reconciliation.
• Where to export reports? Statistics tab, Export report button.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_kiemKeTaiSan.con: Contact HR & Administration for asset inventory support.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_baoTriSuaChua.in: Create maintenance and repair slips for assets; track progress and statistics by type.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_baoTriSuaChua.ov: The Maintenance & repair module is used to create maintenance or repair slips per asset (request date, due date, responsible person, description). The Statistics tab aggregates by type (maintenance/repair) and time; Excel export is available.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_baoTriSuaChua.pe:
• View: See slip list within scope.
• Create/Edit: Create maintenance/repair slips, update status (pending/done).
• Delete: Delete slips (by permission).
• Export: Export slip list and statistics.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_baoTriSuaChua.wo:
1. Create slip: Select asset, type (Maintenance / Repair), request date, due date, responsible person, description.
2. Status: Pending → Completed when done.
3. Statistics tab: Filter by type and date range; view charts and tables; export Excel.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_baoTriSuaChua.qu:
1. Go to Administration → Maintenance & repair.
2. Click Create slip, select asset, type (Maintenance or Repair), fill dates, responsible person, description, save.
3. When done: Open slip, set status to Completed.
4. Statistics tab: View summary, filter and export Excel.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_baoTriSuaChua.gl:
• Maintenance slip: Records a maintenance request (routine or ad hoc).
• Repair slip: Records a repair request when asset is faulty.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_baoTriSuaChua.fa:
• Where to create a slip? From the slip list in the module or from asset detail (Asset catalog) by clicking "Create maintenance/repair slip".
• Can statistics be filtered by date? Yes; the Statistics tab has a date range filter.
guide.modules.hanhChinh_baoTriSuaChua.co: Contact HR & Administration for maintenance & repair support.
guide.modules.khoVan_phieuKho.intro: Warehouse vouchers for receipt, issue and transfer; optional supplier for receipt/issue.
guide.modules.khoVan_phieuKho.overview: The Warehouse vouchers module manages receipt, issue and transfer vouchers. Each voucher has number, date, warehouse (and destination warehouse for transfers), approval status; receipt/issue vouchers can optionally link a supplier. Line items are product and quantity. Creating or updating a voucher updates stock. You can print and download PDF.
guide.modules.khoVan_phieuKho.permission:
• View: See voucher list by type (receipt/issue/transfer).
• Create/Update: Create and edit vouchers, enter line items.
• Delete: Delete vouchers (note impact on stock).
• Export: Print voucher, download PDF from preview page.
guide.modules.khoVan_phieuKho.workflow:
1. Select Receipt / Issue / Transfer tab.
2. Click Add voucher: Enter number, date, select warehouse (and destination for transfer); for receipt/issue you can optionally select supplier.
3. Add line items: product, quantity; for issue/transfer the system warns if quantity exceeds stock.
4. Save voucher → stock is updated. From voucher detail you can Print voucher (opens preview page, download PDF or print).
guide.modules.khoVan_phieuKho.quickStart:
1. Go to Warehouse → Warehouse vouchers.
2. Select Receipt (or Issue / Transfer) tab.
3. Click Add voucher, enter number, date, select warehouse; for receipt/issue you can select supplier.
4. Add product lines and quantities, save.
5. Open voucher detail → click Print voucher to view preview and download PDF.
guide.modules.khoVan_phieuKho.glossary:
• Receipt voucher: Records goods received into warehouse; stock increases.
• Issue voucher: Records goods issued out; stock decreases.
• Transfer voucher: Moves goods from one warehouse to another; source stock decreases, destination increases.
• Supplier: Optional on receipt/issue vouchers to link source or partner.
guide.modules.khoVan_phieuKho.faq:
• Why over-stock warning? For issue/transfer, quantity cannot exceed current stock at warehouse; check quantity or stock.
• Where to print voucher? In voucher detail, click "Print voucher" to open preview page; there you can download PDF or print.
guide.modules.khoVan_phieuKho.contact: Contact the Warehouse team for voucher support.
guide.modules.khoVan_kiemKeKho.intro: Stock count rounds, reconcile book vs actual quantity, adjust stock and print report.
guide.modules.khoVan_kiemKeKho.overview: The Stock count module manages count rounds: create round (draft), select warehouses, generate count list from current stock, enter actual quantity per line, adjust stock by result (match/short/surplus), complete round. Statistics tab and PDF export available.
guide.modules.khoVan_kiemKeKho.permissio:
• View: See count rounds and details.
• Create/Update: Create round, edit draft round, generate count list, enter results.
• Adjust stock: Apply count results to stock (per line or whole round).
• Export: Print count report, download PDF.
guide.modules.khoVan_kiemKeKho.workflow:
1. Create count round (code, name, dates, responsible, select one or more warehouses).
2. Generate count list from stock by warehouse (optional filter by product/category).
3. Enter results: per line enter actual quantity → system computes match/short/surplus.
4. Adjust stock by result (per line or whole round).
5. Complete round. Print report from preview page.
guide.modules.khoVan_kiemKeKho.quickStar:
1. Go to Warehouse → Stock count.
2. Click Create round, enter code, name, dates, responsible, select warehouses, save.
3. Open round detail → Generate count list (optional product/category filter).
4. Enter result per line (actual quantity).
5. Click Adjust stock (line or whole round) → Complete round. Print via Print voucher button.
guide.modules.khoVan_kiemKeKho.glossary:
• Count round: A single stock count in a time period for one or more warehouses.
• Result: Match (book = actual), Short (actual < book), Surplus (actual > book), Not counted.
• Adjust stock: Update book stock to entered actual quantity.
guide.modules.khoVan_kiemKeKho.faq:
• When to generate count list? Only when the round is in Draft status.
• Can I undo after adjusting stock? Adjustment already updates stock; verify before clicking.
guide.modules.khoVan_kiemKeKho.contact: Contact the Warehouse team for stock count support.
guide.modules.khoVan_tonKho.intro: View stock by product, by location and stock statistics.
guide.modules.khoVan_tonKho.overview: The Stock module has tabs: By product (stock per item, filter by category, below minimum), By location (stock per warehouse), Statistics (charts and summary tables). Stock is updated from Warehouse vouchers and Stock count.
guide.modules.khoVan_tonKho.permissions:
• View: See stock by product, by warehouse and statistics.
• Export: Export stock reports (if available).
guide.modules.khoVan_tonKho.workflow:
1. By product tab: Filter by warehouse, category, below minimum; view stock table per item.
2. By location tab: Select warehouse, view stock per item at that warehouse.
3. Statistics tab: View charts and summary by time, warehouse.
guide.modules.khoVan_tonKho.quickStart:
1. Go to Warehouse → Stock.
2. By product tab: Set filters (warehouse, category, below minimum), view table.
3. By location tab: Select warehouse, view stock at warehouse.
4. Statistics tab: View summary and export (if available).
guide.modules.khoVan_tonKho.glossary:
• Stock: Quantity of product at a warehouse (updated from vouchers and count).
• Below minimum: Filter items with stock below warning level.
guide.modules.khoVan_tonKho.faq:
• Stock wrong vs voucher? Check voucher is approved and recorded; stock updates when creating/editing vouchers and when adjusting from count.
• Can I edit stock manually? This module is view-only; adjust via Warehouse vouchers or Stock count.
guide.modules.khoVan_tonKho.contact: Contact the Warehouse team for stock support.
guide.modules.khoVan_baoCaonhapXuatTon.i: Reports for receipt, issue and stock by period and warehouse.
guide.modules.khoVan_baoCaonhapXuatTon.o: The Receipt/Issue/Stock report module provides: Summary by period, Voucher detail, Stock at a point in time. Filter by date range, warehouse, voucher type, voucher status. Excel/PDF export may be available.
guide.modules.khoVan_baoCaonhapXuatTon.p:
• View: See reports within scope.
• Export: Export reports to Excel/PDF.
guide.modules.khoVan_baoCaonhapXuatTon.w:
1. Select tab (Summary by period / Voucher detail / Stock at point in time).
2. Set date range, warehouse, voucher type, status (as per tab).
3. View table and totals; export if needed.
guide.modules.khoVan_baoCaonhapXuatTon.q:
1. Go to Warehouse → Receipt/Issue/Stock report.
2. Select report tab, set filters (date, warehouse, voucher type).
3. View results; click Export to download Excel/PDF (if available).
guide.modules.khoVan_baoCaonhapXuatTon.g:
• Receipt/Issue/Stock (NXT): Summary of in, out and balance.
• Stock at point in time: Balance on a specific date (from vouchers up to that date).
guide.modules.khoVan_baoCaonhapXuatTon.f:
• Where does report data come from? From warehouse vouchers and stock; ensure correct period and warehouse.
• Where to export Excel/PDF? Each tab has an Export button (if enabled).
guide.modules.khoVan_baoCaonhapXuatTon.c: Contact the Warehouse team for NXT report support.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhMucHangHoa.intr: Product catalog: item groups, units of measure and specifications.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhMucHangHoa.over: The Product catalog module manages item groups (categories), units of measure and specifications used by products. The Product list references this catalog. Set up the catalog before entering product details.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhMucHangHoa.perm:
• View: See groups, units, specifications.
• Create/Update: Add and edit catalog.
• Delete: Remove records not in use (care if linked to products).
• Export: Export list (if available).
guide.modules.khoVan_danhMucHangHoa.work:
1. Add item groups (code, name) to classify products.
2. Define units (ea, kg, box…) and specifications if needed.
3. In Product list, select group and unit from catalog.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhMucHangHoa.quic:
1. Go to Warehouse → Product catalog.
2. Add item group (code, name).
3. Add units and specifications (if used).
4. Go to Product list to create products and assign group/unit.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhMucHangHoa.glos:
• Item group: Product category (e.g. Materials, Finished goods).
• Unit of measure: Measurement unit (ea, kg, liter…).
• Specification: Pack or standard description.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhMucHangHoa.faq:
• Delete group fails? Products still use that group; change product group or delete products first.
• Where is catalog used? In Product list when creating/editing products (select group, unit).
guide.modules.khoVan_danhMucHangHoa.cont: Contact the Warehouse team for product catalog support.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachHangHoa.int: Manage product list: code, name, group, unit, stock, price.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachHangHoa.ove: The Product list module manages each product: code, name, group (from Product catalog), unit, stock and price (if any). Products are used in Warehouse vouchers and Stock count. You can filter, search, view detail, create/edit/delete.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachHangHoa.per:
• View: See product list and details.
• Create/Update: Add and edit products.
• Delete: Delete product (only when no vouchers/count lines use it).
• Export: Export list.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachHangHoa.wor:
1. Create product: Code, name, select group and unit from catalog.
2. Stock and price (if any) may be shown/updated per config.
3. Use this product when creating warehouse vouchers and count lists.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachHangHoa.qui:
1. Go to Warehouse → Product list.
2. Click Add, enter code, name, select group and unit, save.
3. Use filters and search to view list; click a product to view/edit detail.
4. When creating vouchers or count, select product from this list.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachHangHoa.glo:
• Product code: Unique code for the item.
• Stock: Current quantity (total or by warehouse per config); updated from vouchers and count.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachHangHoa.faq:
• Can't select product when creating voucher? Check product is active and meets warehouse/filter.
• Delete product fails? Vouchers or count lines still use it; cannot delete or cancel vouchers/rounds first.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachHangHoa.con: Contact the Warehouse team for product list support.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachKho.intro: Manage warehouse list: code, name, address, manager.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachKho.overvie: The Warehouse list module manages warehouses (branches, locations): code, name, address, description, order, status. Warehouses are selected when creating receipt/issue/transfer vouchers and count rounds. List can be imported/exported.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachKho.permiss:
• View: See warehouse list and details.
• Create/Update: Add and edit warehouses.
• Delete: Delete warehouse (only when no vouchers/stock/count use it).
• Export/Import: Export or import warehouse list.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachKho.workflo:
1. Add warehouse: Code, name, address, description, order, status.
2. Warehouse appears in Warehouse vouchers (source/destination) and Stock count (round warehouses), Stock (filter by warehouse).
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachKho.quickSt:
1. Go to Warehouse → Warehouse list.
2. Click Add, enter code, name, address (and description if needed), save.
3. Set status (active/inactive) if needed.
4. New warehouse can be selected in Warehouse vouchers, Stock count and Stock.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachKho.glossar:
• Warehouse: Location where goods are stored (branch, cabinet, shelf).
• Warehouse status: Active (usable) or Inactive (not used for new vouchers).
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachKho.faq:
• Delete warehouse fails? Vouchers, stock or count rounds still use it; move data or set Inactive instead of deleting.
• How to import warehouse list? Use Import button, download template, fill data and upload.
guide.modules.khoVan_danhSachKho.contact: Contact the Warehouse team for warehouse list support.
Manage suppliers: group, code, name, contact; optional on receipt/issue vouchers.

The Supplier list module manages supplier info: code, name, group, address, phone, email, tags. Suppliers can be optionally selected on receipt or issue vouchers in the Warehouse vouchers module. List can be imported/exported.

• View: See supplier list and details.
• Create/Update: Add and edit suppliers.
• Delete: Delete supplier (care if already on vouchers).
• Export/Import: Export or import list.

1. Add supplier: Code, name, group, address, contact, tags.
2. In Warehouse vouchers (Receipt or Issue tab), when creating/editing a voucher you can optionally select supplier.
3. Supplier info appears on voucher and reports.

1. Go to Warehouse → Supplier list.
2. Click Add, enter code, name, group, contact, save.
3. When creating receipt/issue vouchers, you can select supplier from list (optional).

• Supplier: Partner supplying (or receiving) goods.
• Tag: Label for supplier (priority, domestic…) for filtering and classification.

• Is supplier required on voucher? No; the supplier field on receipt/issue vouchers is optional.
• Delete supplier that has vouchers? May be blocked or only hide; depends on config. Prefer setting Inactive instead of delete.
Contact the Warehouse team for supplier support.
